payload.claim: `run_task`'s docstring enumerates the causes of an early `Refused` return (`consumes`, recorded-text refusal, stacking) but was not updated to mention the new mutants-related refusals this change adds (inline mutant, unreadable mutants file, disclosed ref mutant, unresolved mutants commit), so the list no longer matches what the function actually refuses on before any cell starts.
